name: Ahmad Zulkifli
bio:
Ahmad's passion for motorsport ignited during his university days, where he pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering. He specialized in composite materials, drawn to their potential to revolutionize vehicle performance. His first role was at a local tuning shop, where he gained hands-on experience in fabricating and repairing carbon fiber components. This experience fueled his ambition to join a professional racing team. 

Ahmad is a meticulous composite technician, known for his unwavering attention to detail. He believes in a collaborative approach, working closely with engineers and aerodynamicists to optimize designs. He is particularly interested in exploring novel composite layups and resin systems to enhance the stiffness and reduce the weight of vehicle components. He joined AF Corse eager to push the boundaries of composite technology within the team.

His dedication to constant improvement and his innate ability to troubleshoot complex composite issues make him a valuable asset. Ahmad aims to become a leading expert in composite materials within the motorsport industry, pushing the limits of performance through cutting-edge technologies.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas and measurements.
Has a habit of meticulously cleaning his workspace after every task.
